questions.q: A product costs $20 to make. The business uses cost-plus pricing with a 30% mark-up. What is the price?
questions.why: Mark-up is 30% of cost: 20 × 0.30 = 6, so price = 20 + 6 = $26.

questions.q: Setting a high price when a new product is first launched is called:
questions.why: Skimming = high launch price; penetration = low price to enter a market.

questions.q: Demand for a product is price-inelastic. If the price rises by 10%, quantity demanded will:
questions.why: Inelastic: % change in quantity demanded is smaller than the % change in price, so revenue rises.

questions.q: Identify two extension strategies for a product in the maturity stage of its life cycle.
questions.model: Any two: new packaging or design; selling in new markets; adding new features or versions; increased advertising or sales promotions / lower price.
points: e.g. new packaging, new markets, new version, more promotion
